Name: Artisan Workshop
Author: RoyJ549
Description:
[center]
[size=6][b][color=#E8B86D]Artisan Workshop[/color][/b][/size]

[i]One workshop menu for your machines, recipes, materials, and artisan production.[/i]

[color=#BFA98A][b]Current version: v0.2.0[/b][/color]
[/center]


[center][color=#8B7765]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color][/center]


[size=4][b][color=#E8B86D]Overview[/color][/b][/size]

[b]Artisan Workshop[/b] provides a unified interface for browsing supported processing machines, checking recipes and materials, and crafting across locations in your current save.

Instead of walking between machines and inserting materials one by one, open the Workshop, choose a location, select a machine and recipe, and manage your artisan production from one menu.

With optional [b]Remote Crafting[/b] and [b]Global Storage[/b], the Workshop can also operate supported machines in other locations and use materials stored in eligible chests across your save.


[size=4][b][color=#E8B86D]Features[/color][/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Unified Workshop Menu[/b]
Browse supported machines, recipes, required materials, machine status, and craftable quantity from one interface.
[/*]
[*][b]Multi-location Machine Browsing[/b]
Use the location selector to browse supported machines across normal persistent locations in your current save.
[/*]
[*][b]Direct MachineData / EMC Crafting[/b]
Craft through supported vanilla and modded MachineData execution paths instead of directly spawning products.
[/*]
[*][b]Multi-material Recipe Support[/b]
Supports compatible recipes with primary ingredients, additional materials, fuel, and alternative ingredient requirements.
[/*]
[*][b]Dynamic Ingredient Matching[/b]
Supports a range of ingredient semantics such as fruits, vegetables, fish, eggs, preserves, and compatible alternative ingredient groups.
[/*]
[*][b]Chest Material Support[/b]
Crafting materials can be taken from your inventory and supported [b]Chest / Big Chest[/b] storage.
[/*]
[*][b]Optional Remote Crafting[/b]
Operate supported machines in other persistent locations without traveling to the machine first.
[/*]
[*][b]Optional Global Storage[/b]
Allow supported chests in other eligible persistent locations to contribute crafting materials.
[/*]
[*][b]Machine Execution Profiles[/b]
Machines with the same machine ID but different execution behavior can be planned and handled separately.
[/*]
[*][b]Mergable Machines 0.2.0 Compatibility[/b]
Stacked machines are separated by stack size and use the correct stack-scaled material requirements.
[/*]
[*][b]Producer Framework Mod Browsing[/b]
Compatible PFM machines can be discovered and browsed, including recipes, requirements, craftable quantity, and machine state.
[/*]
[*][b]English + Simplified Chinese[/b]
Full interface localization is included.[/*]
[/list]

[center][color=#8B7765]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color][/center]


[size=4][b][color=#E8B86D]Controls & Configuration[/color][/b][/size]

[b]Default hotkey:[/b]

[b]F7[/b] — Open or close Artisan Workshop.

The hotkey can be changed through [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] or [b]config.json[/b].

GMCM is optional and is not required to use Artisan Workshop.


[b]Available settings[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Open Workshop Menu[/b]
Changes the key used to open Artisan Workshop.
[/*]
[*][b]Allow Remote Crafting[/b]
Default: [b]Disabled[/b]

When enabled, supported MachineData / EMC machines in other persistent locations can be operated through the Workshop.

Remote Crafting does not enable execution for PFM-backed machines.
[/*]
[*][b]Chest Inventory Scope[/b]

[b]Selected Location Only[/b] — Default

Materials may come from:
[list]
[*]Player inventory[/*]
[*]Supported chests in the currently selected location[/*]
[/list]
[b]All Persistent Locations[/b]

Materials may additionally come from supported chests in other eligible persistent locations.[/*]
[/list]

[color=#D9B77C][b]Remote Crafting and Chest Inventory Scope are independent settings.[/b][/color]

For example:

[list]
[*]You can use Global Storage while crafting a machine in your current location.[/*]
[*]You can enable Remote Crafting while keeping chest materials limited to the selected location.[/*]
[*]You can enable both to operate a machine in Town while using materials stored in a FarmHouse chest.[/*]
[/list]

[center][color=#8B7765]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color][/center]


[size=4][b][color=#E8B86D]How It Works[/color][/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Open Artisan Workshop.[/*]
[*]Choose a location using the selector at the top of the menu.[/*]
[*]Select a machine group from the left panel.[/*]
[*]Choose a recipe.[/*]
[*]Review the required materials and craftable quantity.[/*]
[*]Craft through the Workshop.[/*]
[/list]
Artisan Workshop resolves materials before execution and keeps the planned material sources attached to that crafting operation.

Before anything is committed, the Workshop rechecks the target location, machine, recipe, material sources, and relevant execution state.

If something has changed since planning — for example, a chest was modified, a machine was replaced, or a stacked machine changed stack size — the operation safely fails instead of silently switching to another material source.


[b][color=#D9B77C]Execution safety[/color][/b]

Artisan Workshop is designed to avoid ambiguous or partially completed crafting operations.

[list]
[*]Material allocations are frozen for each execution attempt.[/*]
[*]The Workshop does not silently re-plan materials during the same operation.[/*]
[*]If one required source becomes invalid, the entire operation fails.[/*]
[*]Materials are validated before commit.[/*]
[*]Target machine and location identity are rechecked.[/*]
[*]Machine state changes can invalidate an old plan safely.[/*]
[/list]

[center][color=#8B7765]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color][/center]


[size=4][b][color=#E8B86D]Remote Crafting[/color][/b][/size]

Remote Crafting is [b]disabled by default[/b].

When enabled, supported MachineData / EMC machines in other normal persistent locations can be operated through Artisan Workshop.

For example:

[list]
[*]Player location: Farm[/*]
[*]Selected Workshop location: Town[/*]
[*]Target machine: Town[/*]
[/list]
The Workshop can execute the Town machine without requiring the player to travel there first.

Remote Crafting only changes [b]where the target machine may be operated[/b].

It does not automatically enable Global Storage.


[size=4][b][color=#E8B86D]Global Storage[/color][/b][/size]

When [b]Chest Inventory Scope[/b] is set to [b]All Persistent Locations[/b], supported chests in other eligible persistent locations can contribute materials.

Material priority is deterministic:

[list=1]
[*]Player inventory[/*]
[*]Selected location[/*]
[*]Other eligible persistent locations[/*]
[*]Chests by stable tile order[/*]
[*]Slots within each chest[/*]
[/list]
The selected location is always preferred before other remote storage locations.

Global Storage currently uses the Workshop's supported [b]Chest / Big Chest[/b] sources.


[center][color=#8B7765]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color][/center]


[size=4][b][color=#E8B86D]Mergable Machines Compatibility[/color][/b][/size]

Artisan Workshop v0.2.0 includes compatibility for the verified [b]Mergable Machines 0.2.0[/b] behavior.

Stacked machines are no longer treated as ordinary single-machine operations.

For compatible stacked machines:

[list]
[*]Different stack sizes are separated into different execution groups.[/*]
[*]Material requirements scale with the machine stack size.[/*]
[*]Primary and compatible additional material requirements are planned before execution.[/*]
[*]Craftable quantity reflects the full stacked-machine requirement.[/*]
[*]Changing the stack size after planning invalidates the old execution safely.[/*]
[*]Remote Crafting and Global Storage can be used with supported stacked machines.[/*]
[/list]
For example:

A machine with [b]Stack ×5[/b] that normally requires:

[list]
[*]1 primary ingredient[/*]
[*]1 additional ingredient[/*]
[/list]
will be planned as requiring:

[list]
[*]5 primary ingredients[/*]
[*]5 additional ingredients[/*]
[/list]
Artisan Workshop does [b]not[/b] calculate or duplicate stacked output itself.

Final stacked output behavior remains handled by Mergable Machines through its own machine execution patches.


[center][color=#8B7765]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color][/center]


[size=4][b][color=#E8B86D]Producer Framework Mod Support[/color][/b][/size]

Artisan Workshop includes browsing support for compatible machines registered through Producer Framework Mod.

Where a PFM rule can be resolved safely, the Workshop can display:

[list]
[*]Available recipes[/*]
[*]Required ingredients and fuel[/*]
[*]Missing materials[/*]
[*]Craftable quantity[/*]
[*]Idle / processing / ready state[/*]
[/list]
[color=#D9B77C][b]PFM recipes are currently browse-only in Artisan Workshop.[/b][/color]

Direct crafting through the Workshop is not currently enabled for PFM-backed machines.

PFM compatibility may vary between content packs depending on how their rules and custom production behavior are implemented.


[center][color=#8B7765]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color][/center]


[size=4][b][color=#E8B86D]Compatibility[/color][/b][/size]

[b]Artisan Workshop does not require Automate.[/b]

Currently supported or integrated:

[list]
[*]Vanilla MachineData machines[/*]
[*]Compatible modded MachineData machines[/*]
[*]Compatible Extra Machine Config / EMC multi-material rules[/*]
[*]Chest / Big Chest material sources[/*]
[*]Remote Crafting for supported MachineData / EMC execution paths[/*]
[*]Global Storage across eligible persistent locations[/*]
[*]Mergable Machines 0.2.0[/*]
[*]Producer Framework Mod machine and recipe browsing[/*]
[/list]
[b]Direct PFM crafting is not currently supported.[/b]


[center][color=#8B7765]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color][/center]


[size=4][b][color=#E8B86D]Current Limitations[/color][/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]PFM-backed recipes are browse-only.[/b]
[/*]
[*]Global Storage currently uses supported Chest / Big Chest sources only.
[/*]
[*]Fridges, Junimo Chest networks, and third-party global storage APIs are not currently included as material sources.
[/*]
[*]Dynamic Mine and Skull Cavern floors are not intended as Global Storage sources.
[/*]
[*]Volcano dungeon areas, festival maps, event maps, and other temporary locations are not guaranteed to support Remote Crafting or Global Storage.
[/*]
[*]Modded locations with unstable or unusual lifecycle behavior may be excluded from Global Storage.
[/*]
[*]Multiplayer cabin and remote-storage synchronization edge cases may require additional compatibility work.
[/*]
[*]Mergable Machines compatibility is currently verified against version [b]0.2.0[/b]. Unverified future versions may safely disable stacked execution if their behavior cannot be confirmed.
[/*]
[*]Machines using production systems outside supported MachineData / EMC / PFM paths may not appear or may not be fully supported.[/*]
[/list]

[center][color=#8B7765]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color][/center]


[size=4][b][color=#E8B86D]Installation[/color][/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b].[/*]
[*]Download Artisan Workshop.[/*]
[*]Extract the [b]ArtisanWorkshop[/b] folder into:

[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/code][/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Press [b]F7[/b] to open Artisan Workshop, or change the hotkey through GMCM / config.json.[/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b][color=#E8B86D]Optional[/color][/b][/size]

[b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b]

GMCM is not required.

If installed, it provides an in-game interface for:

[list]
[*]Changing the Workshop hotkey[/*]
[*]Enabling or disabling Remote Crafting[/*]
[*]Changing the Chest Inventory Scope[/*]
[/list]

[center][color=#8B7765]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color][/center]


[size=4][b][color=#E8B86D]Troubleshooting & Bug Reports[/color][/b][/size]

If you encounter a compatibility issue, please include as much of the following as possible:

[list]
[*]Your SMAPI log[/*]
[*]Machine name[/*]
[*]Machine/content-pack Mod name[/*]
[*]Recipe being crafted[/*]
[*]Current machine state[/*]
[*]Whether Remote Crafting was enabled[/*]
[*]Whether Chest Inventory Scope was set to All Persistent Locations[/*]
[*]Whether the machine was stacked[/*]
[/list]
This makes compatibility issues much easier to reproduce and diagnose.


[center][color=#8B7765]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[/color][/center]
